brief: Implement core/player_controls.gd extending RefCounted for Godot 4.7. Fields: var deadzone: float = 0.15, var pitch_sensitivity: float = 1.0, var turn_sensitivity: float = 1.0, var throttle_sensitivity: float = 1.0, var flight_assist: bool = false. Method toggle_autopilot(sim) -> void: sim.autopilot = not sim.autopilot; sim.pitch_input = 0.0; sim.turn_input = 0.0; sim.throttle_input = 0.0. Method apply_deadzone(stick: Vector2, dz: float) -> Vector2: var l: float = stick.length(); if l <= dz: return Vector2.ZERO; var factor: float = (l - dz) / (1.0 - dz); return stick.normalized() * clampf(factor, 0.0, 1.0). Method apply_flight_input(sim, pitch: float, turn: float, throttle: float) -> void: sim.pitch_input = clampf(pitch, -1.0, 1.0); sim.turn_input = clampf(turn, -1.0, 1.0); sim.throttle_input = clampf(throttle, -1.0, 1.0). Method handle_event(event: InputEvent, sim) -> bool: if event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo: if event.physical_keycode == KEY_TAB: toggle_autopilot(sim); return true; elif event.physical_keycode == KEY_B or event.physical_keycode == KEY_SPACE: if sim.mission.phase == 'BOMBARDEO' and not sim.autopilot and not sim.bomb.spent: sim.release_bomb(); return true; if event is InputEventJoypadButton and event.pressed: if event.button_index == JOY_BUTTON_BACK or event.button_index == JOY_BUTTON_MISC1: toggle_autopilot(sim); return true; elif event.button_index == JOY_BUTTON_B or event.button_index == JOY_BUTTON_A: if sim.mission.phase == 'BOMBARDEO' and not sim.autopilot and not sim.bomb.spent: sim.release_bomb(); return true; return false. Method poll_inputs(sim, delta: float) -> void: if sim.autopilot: return; var pitch: float = (1.0 if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_S) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_DOWN) else 0.0) - (1.0 if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_W) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_UP) else 0.0); var turn: float = (1.0 if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_D) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_RIGHT) else 0.0) - (1.0 if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_A) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_LEFT) else 0.0); var throttle: float = (1.0 if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_SHIFT) else 0.0) - (1.0 if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_CTRL) else 0.0); var joy_stick = Vector2(Input.get_joy_axis(0, JOY_AXIS_LEFT_X), Input.get_joy_axis(0, JOY_AXIS_LEFT_Y)); var filtered_stick = apply_deadzone(joy_stick, deadzone); if filtered_stick.length_squared() > 0.0: turn += filtered_stick.x; pitch += filtered_stick.y; var trigger_rt = Input.get_joy_axis(0, JOY_AXIS_TRIGGER_RIGHT); var trigger_lt = Input.get_joy_axis(0, JOY_AXIS_TRIGGER_LEFT); throttle += (trigger_rt - trigger_lt); apply_flight_input(sim, pitch * pitch_sensitivity, turn * turn_sensitivity, throttle * throttle_sensitivity).
